preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call adminAdd() to add attacker address as admin, then use admin privileges to call initGame() to mint large amounts of HUB tokens to attacker-controlled wallets. Alternatively, use blackListAdd() to block other users from transferring tokens while owner remains unrestricted. The owner can also arbitrarily add/remove signers and admins, controlling all privileged functions.
